function alive(){if(!server)return false;try{process.kill(server.process().pid,0);return true;}catch(e){if(e.code==='ESRCH')return false;throw e;}}
async function bounded(p,ms=5000){let timer;try{return await Promise.race([p,new Promise((_,reject)=>timer=setTimeout(()=>reject(Error('Operation bound exceeded')),ms))]);}finally{clearTimeout(timer);}}
const frames=()=>page.evaluate(()=>new Promise(r=>requestAnimationFrame(()=>requestAnimationFrame(r))));
async function snapshot(){return page.evaluate(()=>{const a=window.__baseCarryPreview,c=document.querySelector('canvas'),gl=c.getContext('webgl2');return{debug:{source_kind:a.source_kind,engine_operation:a.engine_operation,calibration_only:a.calibration_only,source_hashes:a.source_hashes,actor_asset:a.actor_asset,same_objects_across_views:a.same_objects_across_views,animation_loop:a.animation_loop,mode:a.mode,exposed_keys:Object.keys(a)},canvas_count:document.querySelectorAll('canvas').length,view_labels:[...document.querySelectorAll('.labels span')].map(e=>e.textContent),canvas:{width:c.width,height:c.height,context_lost:gl.isContextLost(),final_native_viewport:[...gl.getParameter(gl.VIEWPORT)]},status:document.querySelector('#state').textContent,error:document.querySelector('#error').textContent,buttons:[...document.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b=>({id:b.id,disabled:b.disabled,pressed:b.getAttribute('aria-pressed')}))};});}
async function capture(name){await frames();const state=await snapshot();assert.equal(state.canvas_count,1);assert.equal(state.view_labels.length,3);assert.equal(state.canvas.context_lost,false);assert.equal(state.error,'');assert.equal(state.debug.actor_asset,'worker-base');assert.equal(state.debug.animation_loop,false);assert.deepEqual(state.debug.source_hashes,expected);const file=name+'.png';await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,file),fullPage:true,timeout:5000});captures.push({file,sha256:sha(await readFile(path.join(out,file))),state});}

 await page.goto(url,{waitUntil:'domcontentloaded'});await page.waitForFunction(()=>window.__baseCarryPreview?.mode==='held'&&document.querySelector('canvas')?.width>0,null,{timeout:45000});await Promise.all(pending);assert.equal(browserResponses.length,4);assert.deepEqual(errors,[]);assert.equal(await page.locator('vite-error-overlay').count(),0);

}catch(e){failure??=e.stack??String(e);if(page&&!page.isClosed())try{await page.screenshot({path:path.join(out,'failure.png'),timeout:3000});}catch{}}
